description: Is the smart money long or short this coin? For a Hyperliquid perp ticker, returns how a rules-based cohort of the 120 Hyperliquid accounts with the highest 30-day PnL (public leaderboard) is positioned right now: bias (strong long / lean long / mixed / lean short / strong short), cohort traders long vs short, snapshot age and coverage. Free preview tier. The paid x402 routes add notional and 1h/24h flows (/v1/lite), entries, leverage, liquidation price bands and top positions with truncated addresses (/v1/coin), a market-wide scan (/v1/scan) and live profiles of an account you supply (/v1/wallet). No full addresses or per-account liquidation prices. Read-only analytics on public data; not financial advice.
